description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320290
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
